_comment: Deployment-authored detection rules. Copy to custom_rules.json, edit, and point SCP_CUSTOM_RULES_PATH at it (then redeploy). Each rule is ADDITIVE — it can catch more, never suppress a standard rule. Fields: id (required), name, entity_type, regex, preceding (label/anchor before the value), succeeding (boundary after), action (scrub|obfuscate), enabled, priority, confidence, ignore_case.
